label: GATE FAIL, NIJE MJERODAVNO — SIMULATOR POLICY BENCHMARK ON AN UNCALIBRATED FREE-BURN STRESS SCENARIO; NOT PHYSICAL VALIDATION
interpretation: Frozen base PPO (trained at B=2) lowers added burned area versus no-op at B=2 and B=4 on the 20 VALIDATION fires: -16.6 ha (two-level 95% CI -43.0 to -2.8) and -19.7 ha (-46.7 to -3.1) against a 324.3 ha no-op mean. At B=1 the -5.1 ha effect is marginal (two-level CI -13.2 to +0.5).

Budget-specific fine-tuning shows no measurable gain: fine-tuned minus frozen base is -0.4 ha at B=1 and +0.6 ha at B=4, fine-tuned minus matched control +0.9 and -1.6 ha. With 5 seeds, effects of roughly +/-12-20 ha cannot be excluded (two-level CIs about -5 to +4 ha at B=1 and -15 to +16 ha at B=4).
The downwind heuristic (-28.0 ha at B=2 and B=4) is at least as good as the PPO average; several seeds converge on the same downwind behaviour.
With 90-minute active cells most simulated fires stop within the first 12h, so budgets above 1-2 units rarely find a legal line; this limits any budget-adaptation signal.
Effects are 2-9% of no-op damage; one 1.26 km line per crew shift is small relative to these fires. Results describe SimFire policy behaviour only.
interval_note: scenario_bootstrap_95ci_ha covers scenario variation only; seed_t95ci_ha (t over 5 per-seed means) and two_level_bootstrap_95ci_ha (seeds then scenarios) include seed variation and are the intervals to quote.

supplementary_train_in_sample.purpose: In-sample check run after the VALIDATION result: does budget fine-tuning help even on the fires it trained on?
supplementary_train_in_sample.reading: Same pattern in-sample: frozen base beats no-op (-35.9/-71.3/-99.8 ha at B=1/2/4 against 1,343.6 ha), fine-tuned minus frozen base is -0.9/-13.9 (control)/-8.3 ha with two-level CIs spanning zero, and downwind (-45.8/-77.5/-102.8 ha) is at least as good. The null is not an overfitting artefact.
